teaser: Thursday 17 September. Detroit at Buffalo. Week 1 is in the book. This one is not.
story:
Why this one matters: Week 1 closed 31-10 in Kansas City. Week 2 opens in a building that has not hosted a regular-season snap.

NFL.com and ESPN: Lions at Bills, Highmark Stadium, Orchard Park, 8:15 p.m. ET, Prime Video. Both clubs are 1-0. Buffalo beat Houston 36-31. Detroit beat New Orleans 31-30 in overtime. That is the honest line on 16 September.

Print the time. Print the stadium. Do not print a winner.
stakes: The first Thursday of 2026, in a new stadium, between two clubs that already scored in Week 1.
rivalryAngle: AFC East host, NFC North visitor, a stadium opener instead of a rivalry.
